linear.description: Create a new Linear issue with a title, a team ID and an optional description, priority (0-4) and status.

linear.name: linear_update_issue
linear.description: Update an existing Linear issue's title, description, priority, assignee or status.

linear.name: linear_search_issues
linear.description: Search Linear issues by text, with optional filters for team, status, assignee and priority.

linear.name: linear_get_user_issues
linear.description: Get the issues assigned to a user, or to the authenticated user if no user ID is given.

linear.name: linear_add_comment
linear.description: Add a comment to a Linear issue. Markdown is supported.

github.name: create_issue
github.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository. Requires the repository owner and name, an issue title, and an optional body, labels and assignees. Returns the created issue with its number and URL.

github.name: list_issues
github.description: List issues in a GitHub repository with optional filtering by state, labels, assignee and sort order. Results are paginated; use page and per_page to move through them.

github.name: get_file_contents
github.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository. Provide owner, repo and path, and optionally a branch, tag or commit SHA. Directories return a listing of their entries.

github.name: create_pull_request
github.description: Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository. Specify the head branch that contains your changes and the base branch to merge into, plus a title and optional body. Set draft to true to open it as a draft.

github.name: create_branch
github.description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository from an existing branch or commit. If from_branch is omitted, the repository's default branch is used.

github.name: merge_pull_request
github.description: Merge a pull request in a GitHub repository. Choose the merge method (merge, squash or rebase) and optionally provide a commit title and message.

github.name: add_issue_comment
github.description: Add a comment to an existing issue or pull request in a GitHub repository.

github.name: search_repositories
github.description: Search for GitHub repositories using GitHub's repository search syntax. Supports qualifiers such as language:, stars: and org:. Returns matching repositories with descriptions and star counts.

slack.name: slack_post_message
slack.description: Post a new message to a Slack channel. Provide the channel ID and the message text. Supports Slack mrkdwn formatting.

slack.name: slack_reply_to_thread
slack.description: Reply to a specific message thread in a Slack channel. Requires the channel ID and the timestamp of the parent message (thread_ts).

slack.name: slack_list_channels
slack.description: List public channels in the workspace with pagination. Returns channel IDs, names, topics and member counts.

slack.name: slack_get_channel_history
slack.description: Get recent messages from a Slack channel. Use limit to control how many messages are returned (default 10).

slack.name: slack_add_reaction
slack.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message. Provide the channel ID, the message timestamp and the reaction name without colons.

slack.name: slack_get_users
slack.description: Get a list of all users in the workspace with their basic profile information.

slack.name: slack_get_user_profile
slack.description: Get detailed profile information for a specific user by user ID.

honest_sessions.note: Data scientist with a SQLite app database and DuckDB for Parquet files.

sqlite.name: read_query
sqlite.description: Execute a SELECT query on the SQLite database and return the results.

sqlite.name: write_query
sqlite.description: Execute an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE query on the SQLite database. Returns the number of affected rows.

sqlite.name: create_table
sqlite.description: Create a new table in the SQLite database from a CREATE TABLE statement.

sqlite.name: list_tables
sqlite.description: List all tables in the SQLite database.

sqlite.name: describe_table
sqlite.description: Get the schema information for a specific table, including column names and types.

duckdb.name: query
duckdb.description: Run a SQL query with DuckDB. Can read local Parquet, CSV and JSON files directly by path.

duckdb.name: list_tables
duckdb.description: List the tables and views in the attached DuckDB database.

duckdb.name: describe
duckdb.description: Describe the columns of a table or of a Parquet or CSV file.

honest_sessions.note: Kubernetes operator using kubectl tools and Helm release tools together.

kubernetes.name: kubectl_get
kubernetes.description: Get or list Kubernetes resources of a given kind in a namespace, for example pods, deployments or services. Output can be a table, YAML or JSON.

kubernetes.name: kubectl_describe
kubernetes.description: Describe a Kubernetes resource in detail, including its events.

kubernetes.name: kubectl_logs
kubernetes.description: Get logs from a pod or from one container in a pod. Supports tail, since and previous.

kubernetes.name: kubectl_apply
kubernetes.description: Apply a Kubernetes YAML manifest to the cluster. Creates the resources or updates them if they already exist.

kubernetes.name: kubectl_delete
kubernetes.description: Delete Kubernetes resources by kind and name, or by label selector.

kubernetes.name: port_forward
kubernetes.description: Forward a local port to a port on a pod or service.

helm.name: helm_list
helm.description: List the Helm releases in a namespace.

helm.name: helm_install
helm.description: Install a Helm chart as a new release with an optional values file.

helm.name: helm_upgrade
helm.description: Upgrade a Helm release to a new chart version or new values.

helm.name: helm_get_values
helm.description: Get the values of a Helm release.

helm.name: helm_rollback
helm.description: Roll back a Helm release to an earlier revision.

honest_sessions.note: Team that hosts code on GitLab and tracks work in Jira.

gitlab.name: create_issue
gitlab.description: Create a new issue in a GitLab project. Provide the project ID or URL-encoded path, a title, and an optional description, labels and assignee IDs.

gitlab.name: list_issues
gitlab.description: List issues in a GitLab project. Filter by state (opened, closed, all), labels, milestone or assignee.

gitlab.name: create_merge_request
gitlab.description: Create a merge request in a GitLab project from a source branch into a target branch. Supports a title, description, draft status and reviewers.

gitlab.name: list_merge_requests
gitlab.description: List merge requests for a GitLab project. Filter by state (opened, closed, merged, all), target branch, author or labels.

gitlab.name: get_file_contents
gitlab.description: Get the contents of a file from a GitLab project repository at a given ref. Content is returned decoded as text when possible.

gitlab.name: search_projects
gitlab.description: Search GitLab projects visible to the authenticated user by name or path.

gitlab.name: list_pipelines
gitlab.description: List CI/CD pipelines for a GitLab project, newest first. Filter by status, ref or source.

jira.name: jira_get_issue
jira.description: Get details of a Jira issue by key, including summary, status, assignee, description and recent comments.

jira.name: jira_search
jira.description: Search Jira issues with JQL (Jira Query Language). Returns issue keys, summaries and statuses. Use fields to limit the returned fields.

jira.name: jira_create_issue
jira.description: Create a new Jira issue in a project. Provide the project key, issue type and summary, and optionally a description, assignee and labels.

jira.name: jira_update_issue
jira.description: Update fields of an existing Jira issue.

jira.name: jira_get_transitions
jira.description: List the transitions available for a Jira issue in its current status.

jira.name: jira_transition_issue
jira.description: Move a Jira issue to a new status using a transition ID. Use jira_get_transitions to find valid transitions.

jira.name: jira_add_comment
jira.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue. Supports Jira wiki markup.

honest_sessions.note: Developer with a Supabase project and a separate self-hosted PostgreSQL database.

supabase.name: list_projects
supabase.description: List all Supabase projects for the user.

supabase.name: list_tables
supabase.description: List all tables in one or more schemas of a Supabase project's database.

supabase.name: execute_sql
supabase.description: Execute raw SQL in a Supabase project's Postgres database. Use apply_migration for DDL changes.

supabase.name: apply_migration
supabase.description: Apply a SQL migration to the database. The migration is recorded so it can be tracked.

supabase.name: list_migrations
supabase.description: List the migrations that have been applied to the database.

supabase.name: get_logs
supabase.description: Get logs for a Supabase project by service type, such as api, postgres or auth.

postgres.name: query
postgres.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the connected PostgreSQL database. Statements are executed inside a READ ONLY transaction. Returns the rows as JSON.

postgres.name: list_schemas
postgres.description: List the schemas in the current database, excluding system schemas.

postgres.name: list_tables
postgres.description: List all tables in the given schema (default public) with their estimated row counts.

postgres.name: describe_table
postgres.description: Describe the columns of a table: name, data type, nullability and default value, plus its primary key and indexes.

postgres.name: explain_query
postgres.description: Show the execution plan PostgreSQL chooses for a SQL query, using EXPLAIN. Set analyze to true to run the query and include actual timings.

honest_sessions.note: User whose files are split between Google Drive and Dropbox.

gdrive.name: gdrive_search
gdrive.description: Search for files in Google Drive by name or full text.

gdrive.name: gdrive_read_file
gdrive.description: Read the contents of a Google Drive file. Google Docs are exported as markdown, Sheets as CSV and Slides as plain text.

gdrive.name: gdrive_list_folder
gdrive.description: List the files in a Google Drive folder.

gdrive.name: gdrive_create_file
gdrive.description: Create a new file in Google Drive with the given name, MIME type and content.

gdrive.name: gdrive_move_file
gdrive.description: Move a file to a different Google Drive folder.

dropbox.name: dropbox_search
dropbox.description: Search for files and folders in Dropbox by name.

dropbox.name: dropbox_read_file
dropbox.description: Download a file from Dropbox and return its text content.

dropbox.name: dropbox_list_folder
dropbox.description: List the contents of a Dropbox folder.

dropbox.name: dropbox_upload_file
dropbox.description: Upload a file to a path in Dropbox. Set mode to overwrite to replace an existing file.

dropbox.name: dropbox_create_shared_link
dropbox.description: Create a shared link for a file or folder in Dropbox.

honest_sessions.note: Two internal APIs wrapped by the same OpenAPI-to-MCP generator, both with a health endpoint.

petstore-api.name: get_health
petstore-api.description: Calls GET /health. Returns the service health status. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

petstore-api.name: list_pets
petstore-api.description: Calls GET /pets. Returns a paginated list of pets. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

petstore-api.name: get_pet
petstore-api.description: Calls GET /pets/{petId}. Returns one pet by ID. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

petstore-api.name: create_pet
petstore-api.description: Calls POST /pets. Creates a pet. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

billing-api.name: get_health
billing-api.description: Calls GET /health. Returns the service health status. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

billing-api.name: list_accounts
billing-api.description: Calls GET /accounts. Returns a paginated list of billing accounts. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

billing-api.name: get_account
billing-api.description: Calls GET /accounts/{accountId}. Returns one billing account by ID. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

billing-api.name: list_charges
billing-api.description: Calls GET /accounts/{accountId}/charges. Returns the charges of an account. Generated from the OpenAPI specification by openapi-mcp.

honest_sessions.note: Automation developer using local Playwright and a Browserbase cloud browser for sites that block headless browsers.

playwright.name: browser_navigate
playwright.description: Navigate to a URL in the current tab.

playwright.name: browser_snapshot
playwright.description: Capture an accessibility snapshot of the current page. This is better than a screenshot for deciding what to click, because each element gets a stable ref.

playwright.name: browser_click
playwright.description: Perform a click on an element in the page. Use the element ref from the latest snapshot.

playwright.name: browser_type
playwright.description: Type text into an editable element. Optionally press Enter after typing to submit.

playwright.name: browser_take_screenshot
playwright.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot; use browser_snapshot for actions.

playwright.name: browser_tabs
playwright.description: List, create, close or select browser tabs.

playwright.name: browser_wait_for
playwright.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear, or for a set number of seconds to pass.

browserbase.name: browserbase_session_create
browserbase.description: Create a new cloud browser session on Browserbase.

browserbase.name: browserbase_navigate
browserbase.description: Navigate the cloud browser session to a URL.

browserbase.name: browserbase_click
browserbase.description: Click an element on the page, described in plain language or by selector.

browserbase.name: browserbase_type
browserbase.description: Type text into an input on the page.

browserbase.name: browserbase_screenshot
browserbase.description: Take a screenshot of the current page in the cloud browser.

browserbase.name: browserbase_session_close
browserbase.description: Close the current cloud browser session.

honest_sessions.note: Windows user with the filesystem server for project folders and Everything search for whole-disk lookups.

filesystem.name: read_file
filesystem.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and returns a clear error message if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: write_file
filesystem.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution, as it overwrites existing files without warning. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: edit_file
filesystem.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces an exact text sequence with new content. Returns a git-style diff of the changes made. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: list_directory
filesystem.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Entries are prefixed with [FILE] or [DIR] so files and directories are easy to tell apart. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: search_files
filesystem.description: Recursively search for files and directories whose names match a pattern, starting from the given path. Returns the full paths of all matching items. Only searches within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: get_file_info
filesystem.description: Retrieve metadata about a file or directory, including size, creation time, last modified time, permissions and type. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: create_directory
filesystem.description: Create a new directory, including any missing parent directories. Succeeds silently if the directory already exists. Only works within allowed directories.

filesystem.name: move_file
filesystem.description: Move or rename a file or directory. Fails if the destination already exists. Only works within allowed directories.

everything-search.name: search_files
everything-search.description: Search for files and folders across all local drives using the Everything index. Supports wildcards, regex, path: and ext: filters. Results are returned almost instantly.

everything-search.name: search_by_size
everything-search.description: Find files larger or smaller than a given size.

everything-search.name: search_recent
everything-search.description: Find files modified within the last N days.
